mapper.select: SELECT i.img_block_id AS imgBlockId, i.img_id AS imgId, i.original_name AS originalName, i.image_url AS imageUrl, i.caption AS caption, i.order_index AS orderIndex, i.created_at AS createdAt, stats.total_count AS totalCount FROM image i JOIN ( SELECT img_block_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count, MIN(order_index) AS min_order_index FROM image WHERE img_block_id IN #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY img_block_id ) stats ON stats.img_block_id = i.img_block_id AND stats.min_order_index = i.order_index WHERE i.img_block_id IN #{id} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
